EmailTemplate.description: Email sent to Opportunity Owner's manager if the opportunity is in Current stage past SLA and 14 days
EmailTemplate.name: Opportunity SLA Breach Supervisor
EmailTemplate.subject: Weekly Summary: Opportunities Requiring Review in Sales CRM
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Weekly Summary: Opportunities Requiring Review in Sales CRM
Weekly Summary: Opportunities Requiring Review in Sales CRM
Hello [NAME] ,
The following opportunities under your team have remained without updates for more than 14 days after an SLA breach in the Sales CRM.
To ensure visibility and progress, please review the list below and work with the corresponding sellers to take the necessary action. If a listed seller is inactive, please help update the opportunity with the appropriate owner.
Opportunities Requiring Attention: [REQUIRED_FIELDS]
You can view all opportunities currently breaching SLAs in the following report: Opportunity Report
This is a visibility summary to support data quality and ensure timely updates across your team's pipeline.
Sales Excellence
